bayts.text: (Upon him) what cannot be counted of blessing and peace, from Him Who through him has led to me the most excellent speech.
The peace of Him with Whom what is never runs out (be) upon him to whose eulogy I hasten.
My gift, from Muḥarram until Jumādā the Second, has brought a precious gift (lit. "of deep red").
From Rajab until the end of Dhū l-Ḥijja, for him there are upon me blessings, as proof.
The Benefiter has benefited me through the Benefited one, the Foremost, the Preferred, the Exalted.
The two purest peaces of Him Who gifted me the wishes (be) upon him for whom my being (servant) has not remained hidden.
To the Chosen I have addressed virgin (unprecedented) eulogies, and through his praise harm has turned back from me.
To the Chosen I have addressed virgin blessings, with a peace through which his company glories in me.
The Everlasting has guided me without straying, and through the Prophet He leads His lawful to me.
The Everlasting, the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), has turned might to me, and through me He glories in His party, the mighty.
It has gladdened me that the Generous is the Most Generous, and I shall never cease to be honoured.
I was the guest of the Generous and He made the hospitality good for me, and through me He guided dwellings together with villages.
To Him is my address, and He has made my heart good; and it is not I who repel nor I who draw.
For me You have drawn and from me You have repelled what You chose for me, and the reverse, O Possessor of favour.
You have given me possession, You have given me the power to dispose of a possession, the finest disposal, that rose above kings.
Your "Be!" and it is leads my request to me with security: already I am well pleased with You.
You have given me the Qurʾān and the sciences, and through me You have benefited the ignorant and the learned.
You have driven benefit to me without harm, You have turned good toward me without evil.
You have driven to me the guarded, well-composed (knowledge); You have accepted from me the repeated pearls.
You have guided me with Your wise Remembrance, and turned to me the most beneficial judgement.
You have accepted my praise in Your mighty measure, concerning him to whom You gave the well-strung pearls.
You have kept me safe from every evil and trial, and I have become free, while others than me were fettered.
You have turned to me the freedom of a sovereign, a king, free of need of kings and of the (long) wayfaring.
You have given me refuge, through the Chosen, with You, (as) intimate and beloved forever with You.
I have turned all of me to the Generous and the Beautiful, and to the Loving, the Lord: from Him I do not swerve.
The Generous has honoured me, how excellent the Benefiter; and how lovely the Benefiter, and He is the Exalter!
The peace of an Everlasting, Protecting and Subtle One (be) upon him whose generosity circles around me.
The peace of a Sufficing One, the best Repeller, Who has benefited, the most beneficial Exalter, (be) upon him who has been exalted.
The blessing of the Everlasting, the Protector, the Subtle (be) upon the Prophet, the Chosen, the compassionate.
Upon him to whom (go) from me blessing and peace: to him from Allah be blessing and peace.
I have addressed to the Chosen, every day, services of praises that removed my blame.
To the Prophet I have addressed, every night, services of praises that made my attainment sublime.
He has been pleased with me to Whom (belong) my creeds, my speech and action, and He is my leader.
I was the guest of Him Who made my hospitality good for me, and He led to me what He did not show the (spiritual) Poles.
He has turned to me what others than me do not see, a miracle that endures by the leave of the Best.
Toward me Allah has led, in the two Abodes, something through which He made me protected (lit. "two neighbours").
The Benefiter has benefited me with a benefit that surpassed (all others), and has already effaced hypocrisy from my breast.
The Generous, the Honourer, has honoured me, by the standing of him whose name is the Honoured.
To me the blessing of the Chosen has led what it led, without harm, well-pleasing, and it yielded.
To me He has led what is gladness for me, and toward me He does not turn the chills (of misfortune).
The gift of God and the Messenger has turned toward me, and I have obtained my request.
The Lord of night and day has turned to me the good of both, together, without rebuke.
Toward me He to Whom the days belong has led that beneath which lie fasting and the night vigil.
To me He to Whom the months belong leads that beneath which lie purity and purification.
To me He to Whom the years belong leads what, through me, has led the obligatory and the Sunna.
He is the Generous, the Benefiter, the Honourer; and His servant, the best of creation, is the Honoured.
He has repelled harm from turning toward me, by His mighty measure: how excellent is my Intimate!
He has turned to me what will never cease to be the perpetuated gladness of every successful one.
It has gladdened me to be without troubles, in this abode and in that abode,
guest of the Generous, the Beautiful and the Loving, Lord of creation, and through me forefathers are honoured.
To Allah I have addressed all praise, and He has already effaced the harm of error and of intent.
Upon the Prophet, the best of creation, the best blessing and the best peace, that brings glad tidings to his company.
There has become clear to me the being (for me) of the Messenger of Allah — upon him the best of Allah's blessings —
the certainty of my heart, after my Lord and the Book: I have become his servant, and he has driven away reproach.
Muḥammad is the best of all creation, and he has been for me, by Allah, the best of beings.
